prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object approached, take it, move, check properties, then execute task, release. Else approach or scan. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Action ID = ReleaseObject    />  <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />  <Condition ID = IsObjectValid    />  <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    />  <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = TakeObject    />     <Action ID = MoveToLocation    />     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectValid    />         <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    />         <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />     </Sequence>     <Action ID = ReleaseObject    /> </Sequence>  <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> </Sequence>  <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToLocation
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectValid? THEN
				DO CheckObjectProperties
		ELSE
			DO SpecificTask
		END
		DO ReleaseObject
	END
